The 4 Ps of marketing are `product, price, place, and promotion` , which form a foundational framework known as the marketing mix.[[1]](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/f/four-ps.asp)

### The Core 4 Ps

- **Product:** What your company sells, including its features, quality, design, branding, and packaging. It must solve a real customer problem or fulfill a specific need.[[1]](https://www.ama.org/marketing-news/the-four-ps-of-marketing/)[[2]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/mix/)[[3]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/4-ps-marketing/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BkYUQPORoEw&t=25)
- **Price:** The amount of money customers pay for the item or service. Pricing strategies involve balancing business costs and profit goals with perceived customer value.[[1]](https://www.scu.edu/business/blog/business-concepts/what-are-the-4-ps-of-marketing/)[[2]](https://www.ama.org/marketing-news/the-four-ps-of-marketing/)[[3]](https://www.forbes.com/advisor/business/4-ps-marketing/)[[4]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HFjbrjWjUWc)
- **Place:** Where your product is sold and how it is distributed or delivered to the target market, spanning physical stores and digital e-commerce channels.[[1]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/mix/)[[2]](https://www.ama.org/marketing-news/the-four-ps-of-marketing/)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BkYUQPORoEw&t=25)
- **Promotion:** All the advertising, public relations, social media outreach, and sales strategies used to communicate value and persuade customers to buy.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BkYUQPORoEw&t=25)[[2]](https://www.ama.org/marketing-news/the-four-ps-of-marketing/)[[3]](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/f/four-ps.asp)

### How They Work Together

- The 4 Ps are interdependent; a strong product or great ad cannot overcome a bad price or poor distribution.
- Marketers align all four pillars to create a cohesive strategy that targets customer needs.
- For service-based businesses, the framework is often expanded into the **7 Ps** by adding people, process, and physical evidence.[[1]](https://charisma.edu.eu/insight/4-ps-of-marketing/)[[2]](https://www.scu.edu/business/blog/business-concepts/what-are-the-4-ps-of-marketing/)[[3]](https://www.investopedia.com/terms/f/four-ps.asp)[[4]](https://www.salesforce.com/marketing/mix/)
